title: Tous nobles coeurs (La Rue)
desc: Pierre de la Rue, Tous nobles coeurs. 3 voices (Discantus, Tenor, Baripsaltes), each on its own staff. From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Rue3023); encoded by Jesse Rodin. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0; converted to Cantare notation (tools/kern2cantare.py). Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve); coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff. No text in this edition.
